LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO DRAWING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.1: Introduction to Drawing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Introduction to Drawing
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How are drawings used in technical communication?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication
2. draw types of lines used in drawing
3. appreciate the role of drawing in communication
4. used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing
